rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person, remark, or tone that comes across as sarcastic or snarky.

example.english: You’re so sarcastic—I only asked you one question.
example.traditional: 你咁串，問你一句啫，使唔使咁呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 cyun3 man6 nei5 jat1 geoi3 ze1 sai2 m4 sai2 gam3 aa3

rows.note: Use this when the sarcasm is indirect, passive-aggressive, or delivered in an unpleasantly odd tone.

example.english: They always speak in a sarcastic, passive-aggressive way, which makes people uncomfortable.
example.traditional: 佢成日陰陽怪氣咁講嘢，聽到人好唔舒服。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 jam1 joeng4 gwaai3 hei3 gam3 gong2 je5 teng1 dou3 jan4 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this for explicitly describing a remark or expression as containing sarcasm, especially in a more explanatory style.

example.english: This remark is sarcastic; it isn’t really praising me.
example.traditional: 呢句說話帶諷刺意味，唔係真係讚我。
example.jyutping: ne1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 daai3 fung3 ci3 ji3 mei6 m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 zaan3 ngo5
